name: Terrorhythm Recordings
editorial_article:
Terrorhythm Recordings is a London-based independent record label that has served as a cornerstone of the UK underground bass scene for over two decades. Founded in 2004 by the visionary DJ and producer Plastician (originally known as Plasticman), the label emerged during the formative years of grime and dubstep, providing a critical platform for artists to define the evolving sonic palette of early-2000s electronic music. Terrorhythm gained an early reputation for releasing raw, experimental, and heavy-hitting sounds that bridged the gap between the frantic energy of grime and the space-age, sub-bass-heavy textures of early dubstep.

Throughout its active years, the label has been instrumental in shaping the careers of foundational figures in the bass music landscape. Artists such as Joker, Jakes, and Macabre Unit were key early contributors, helping establish a label aesthetic that favored technical production and uncompromising low-end pressure. As the music industry shifted, Terrorhythm proved adaptable, moving seamlessly from its roots in 12-inch vinyl culture to become a digital-forward platform that continued to champion new talent, including later explorations into trap-influenced bass music. The label's longevity is a testament to Plastician's influence as an A&R, curating a roster that never felt constrained by genre labels, but rather focused on the visceral experience of bass-heavy club music. By maintaining a constant presence in the UK scene, Terrorhythm Recordings has preserved its legacy as a pivotal institution that helped transition underground UK electronic music into the global phenomenon it is today.
